recipes.title: Gridfinity bin
recipes.summary: A bin for the 42 mm Gridfinity grid: spec feet and stacking lip, compartments, scoops, a label tab, and magnet or screw pockets under every foot.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Gridfinity baseplate
recipes.summary: The grid Gridfinity bins lock into: spec sockets, margins that fill a drawer, and an optional floor with magnet pockets or screw holes.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Box with lid
recipes.summary: A storage box sized from the inside, with a sliding, press-on or hinged lid, optional dividers and a label recess; box and lid print side by side without support.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: SKÅDIS pegboard accessory
recipes.summary: A hook, cup, shelf, tool rack or bin for an IKEA SKÅDIS pegboard, on real SKÅDIS pegs (5 × 15 mm slots, 40 mm pitch). Prints without supports.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Phone and tablet stand
recipes.summary: A leaning desk stand for a phone, tablet or e-reader, sized to the device's thickness with its case, with a charging cut-out and a tip-over estimate.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Cable organizer
recipes.summary: Snap-in channels for cables of a measured diameter, on a stick-on or screw-down base or a clamp for the edge of a desk. Each lip is a finger that bends on its own.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Under-desk hanger
recipes.summary: An under-desk hook for headphones or a controller that clamps onto the desk's edge or screws under it. Printed on its side for strength; no supports.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Shelf bracket
recipes.summary: An L-bracket for a shelf of measured depth: a sweeping web, countersunk wall screws and a screw up into the shelf, printed on its side for strength, with a load estimate.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Hose and pipe adapter
recipes.summary: Joins any two hoses, pipes or vacuum fittings: each end goes inside or over what it meets, with a measured fit, optional barbs and a support-free transition.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Self-watering planter
recipes.summary: A reservoir pot and an inner pot sized to your nursery pot: a cotton wick keeps the soil moist for days. Self-centring flange, fill notch, smooth or fluted.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Faceted vase and lamp shade
recipes.summary: A low-poly vase of flat, twisted facets with a belly and neck you shape; prints hollow or in vase mode, or as a lamp shade for an E27 holder.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Battery and card holder
recipes.summary: A tray for AA, AAA, 18650, coin cells, 9 V, SD and microSD cards or USB sticks: pockets sized from the standards, finger grooves, soft edges.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Electronics enclosure
recipes.summary: A box and screw-down lid for a circuit board: corner bosses for heat-set inserts or self-tapping screws, PCB standoffs on the board's hole pattern, USB-C and round wall cut-outs, and lid vents.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Fit coupon
recipes.summary: A slot comb for calibrating internal-feature accuracy on your printer and material.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Cable clip
recipes.summary: A screw-down clip that snaps over a cable of measured diameter, with a fit model for the bore.
recipes.author: kaizensx
